questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 15 cm and a height of 10 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 15 × 10 = 75 cm². Always halve after multiplying.
